card.title: Nintendo Switch Motherboard Component Identification and Capacitor Specifications

source.title: Nintendo Switch Motherboard Component Identification Map

claims.statement: The charging port (Molex 503566-1100) is soldered onto the motherboard and requires a hot air soldering tool for replacement.
claims.evidence: Text description and annotated charging port connector.

card.caveats: The image shows component callouts and text instructions for replacing the charging port, but does not provide voltage or resistance measurements.
